report_name: Education Sector Faces Highest Cyberattack Intensity: SonicWall Report

threat_actors.name: Ryuk
threat_actors.description: A sophisticated ransomware group mentioned as an example of threat actors conducting campaigns against the education sector.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exploited vulnerabilities in public-facing VoIP systems, IP cameras, and web applications running vulnerable Log4j libraries to gain initial access to education sector networks.

attack_patterns.name: Exploitation of Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: VoIP services were targeted by attackers exploiting protocols like SIP to gain access or disrupt services. A single signature for SIPVicious VoIP exploitation accounted for over half of all intrusion events.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Ryuk ransomware was used to encrypt data for financial gain as the final objective of attacks against the education sector.

malware.name: Ryuk
malware.description: A ransomware family actively used in campaigns against the education sector, detected in 44 organizations.

tools.name: SIPVicious
tools.description: A VoIP exploitation tool used for widespread, automated scanning and exploitation of insecure Voice over IP systems in the education sector.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2021-44228
vulnerabilities.description: The Log4j2 vulnerability was still being actively exploited against the education sector, generating 6.7 million hits, indicating vulnerable learning management and admin systems are still common.

vulnerabilities.name: Hikvision IP Camera Command Injection
vulnerabilities.description: A 2021 command injection vulnerability in old Hikvision IP camera firmware was detected on 605 devices across 28% of education networks.

identities.name: Education Sector
identities.description: Identified as the most intensely targeted industry in H1 2026, facing the highest volume of attacks per device due to its open network environments and prevalence of unpatched systems.

indicators.name: SIPVicious VoIP Scanning Activity
indicators.pattern:
title: SIPVicious VoIP Scanning Activity
id: 9a7b6c5d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d
status: experimental
description: Detects a high volume of UDP traffic on port 5060, which is indicative of scanning activity by tools like SIPVicious targeting VoIP systems.
references:
  - https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sonicwall-research-issues-education-cybersecurity-report-card-as-attackers-exploit-the-industrys-most-open-networks-302867053.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-02
tags:
  - attack.t1210
level: medium
logsource:
  category: firewall
detection:
  selection:
    dst_port: 5060
    protocol: udp
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic patterns indicative of SIPVicious scanning against VoIP systems, as highlighted in the SonicWall report.

indicators.name: Log4j JNDI Injection Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Log4j JNDI Injection Attempt
id: 8b6c5d4e-2f3a-4b2c-9d5e-6f7a8b9c0d1e
status: experimental
description: Detects attempts to exploit the Log4j vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228) via JNDI injection strings in web requests or other loggable data.
references:
  - https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sonicwall-research-issues-education-cybersecurity-report-card-as-attackers-exploit-the-industrys-most-open-networks-302867053.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-02
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: critical
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '${jndi:ldap://'
      - '${jndi:dns://'
      - '${jndi:rmi://'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the common `jndi:ldap://` pattern used in Log4j exploitation attempts, which the report notes are still prevalent in the education sector.

indicators.name: Hikvision Camera Command Injection Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Hikvision Camera Command Injection Attempt
id: 7c5d4e3f-3a4b-4c1d-8e6f-7a8b9c0d1e2f
status: experimental
description: 'Detects web requests targeting a known command injection vulnerability in Hikvision IP cameras.'
references:
  - https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sonicwall-research-issues-education-cybersecurity-report-card-as-attackers-exploit-the-industrys-most-open-networks-302867053.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-02
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '/SDK/webLanguage'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects exploit attempts against the 2021 Hikvision IP camera command injection flaw mentioned in the report.
